title: The Science Fair Surprise
text: Ava spent three weeks building a model volcano for the science fair, mixing baking soda and vinegar to make it erupt. The night before the fair, she practiced her eruption one final time in the kitchen sink. As she poured in the vinegar, she noticed she had used far more baking soda than usual. Bubbling red foam began rising quickly toward the top of the volcano, faster than ever before. Ava's little brother ran into the kitchen, drawn by the fizzing sound. Ava barely had time to shout a warning before the foam reached the rim.
